title: Review of c14's catalyst-rods no-selection negative: replicated on fresh seed 2 (40000 steps: rate y 1.0035 vs inert marker 1.0088, no trend; 45-62% of particles inside rods)
summary: Ran c14's yz.py on the finding's world.py with mutation on (muy 0.01, step 0.1, range [0, 2]) on fresh seed 2 for 40000 steps (t=2000), and a labkit pack of the same world and seed (20000 steps). Rods form from noise and settle at 16-25; the particle-mean production rate inside rods wanders between 0.996 and 1.004 and ends at 1.0035 against 1.0088 for the identically inherited and mutated inert marker, with no trend in either (yz_s2.txt); 45-62% of the particles are inside rods after the first census. labkit: 18 rods at the end, 6 persistent splits, generation 2, merge/split 0.27, surfactant s membrane-like.

observations.negative: yz_s2.txt: y 0.996-1.004 vs marker z 0.994-1.009 over 40000 steps, no trend; in_rods 0.45-0.62

controls_run.H: identical-event inert marker z in the same run (yz_s2.txt)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, t=2000 as in the finding. I did not measure the flux of particles between rods through the bath directly; the in-rod fraction is the only evidence for sharing.
